results.id: FINDING FT56 duplicate course partitions (UNION ALL)
results.detail: Sub-query ft UNION ALLs the per-fund aggregates of gen_ftcurrentyear and gen_ftpreviousyear without aggregating them again. When both year tables have qualifying rows, the join fm.Gen_fundmainId = ft.gen_fundnumber returns 2 rows per (TI, fund). The guard cp.gen_coursepartitionId IS NULL is evaluated once, before any create. Update CoursePartition external does re-aggregate, in an outer GROUP BY (DTSX 75517). In addition, a customer account with several open type 1/7 TIs pairs every fund with every TI.

CP-JO uses these LogicalNames: gen_customername "gen_transferin"; gen_product "gen_coursepartition"; gen_agent, gen_agency and gen_consultingbankname "gen_fundmain"; gen_supervisor "gen_agentcontract". TI-JO uses "gen_customeraccount" for gen_contactname, gen_accountname and gen_automatedjoining. The FT56 writer uses contact, product, gen_agents, gen_agencie, systemuser and account. The runtime effect cannot be verified.

results.id: OBSERVATION Create CP - Joining Only duplicate/re-create risk (not claimed by analyst)
results.detail: Hypothesis from the SQL structure (DTSX 42623), not proven at runtime. (a) The source returns more than one row for the same (TI, fund) when the automated joining has 2 course partitions with the same gen_product, or when several CP2 rows satisfy the OR branch. This creates duplicate course partitions in one run. (b) The CP2 test is evaluated per CP2 row (OR), not as NOT EXISTS. A TI that already has a CP2 on the same fund with a product different from the fund type keeps qualifying, so a new course partition can be created on every run. Should be added as unverified. Re-check: this is now recorded in the mapping-A notes as an UNVERIFIABLE RISK. The verdict stays UNVERIFIABLE.

results.id: OBSERVATION ExecuteBulk failure re-send (all SDK writers)
results.detail: ExecuteBulk runs inside the per-row try block. If it throws (for example the "no response" ApplicationException), the entity list is not cleared and the error is attributed to the current row only. The same batch is then sent again on the next call, which can produce duplicates for Create writers. CRM.Proxy semantics are external (blocked_external_dependency).
